speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then it wants a finger, and the fish is threepence, and I am not arguing with a loaf. Sit.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The Shrew is at two, sir. Are you in it today?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not in it. I was in it on Tuesday. Today I am at this table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then sit down. A man who is not in the afternoon may still eat the fish while it is hot.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is another bill. I heard it off the stair and I cannot read it. A comedy, they said, at the other house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Grecian Comedy. The Rose. I am not going. Gib may have the stair, and the river may have the play.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I have one poet at the board and I do not mean to lend him to two yards in one afternoon. Eat.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is on the bread-board's far end. He is not eating the short bit. He has standards, mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He has a mistress who counts. Move him, or leave him, and give Master Shakespeare the plate before the threepence buys a cold fish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have the plate. I am in for the day. Nothing on the desk is going out of the house.
